messages:
Maya Brooks: Nimbus Data flagged a sharp spike on their April invoice. They say usage jumped on 2026-04-05 between 02:00-02:20 UTC. Can eng confirm if this is real usage or a metering glitch?
Owen Li: I looked at the billing ledger and the interleaved backfill audit. There was a corrective backfill on 2026-04-05 02:05 that should've applied +860k tokens, but it looks like the same backfill job committed twice due to the retry controller.
Tess Morgan: Who triggered the backfill? Any human approval?
Owen Li: Backfill was kicked off automatically by a scheduled reconciliation job (recon-backfill-runner) after it detected a missing window. The job has an idempotency token but our commit path didn't check for prior ledger txn_id, so a retry after a transient DB timeout wrote a duplicate set.
Maya Brooks: Can you paste the quick query showing the duplicate counts?
Owen Li: Sure — quick diff from ledger_shadow:```sql
SELECT event_type, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM metering_ledger_shadow
WHERE org='nimbus' AND ts >= '2026-04-05T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-04-05T02:30:00Z'
GROUP BY event_type;
-- result: original_ingest: 860000
-- result: backfill_commit: 860000
-- result: backfill_commit_retry: 860000
-- total billed currently: 2,580,000
-- expected (without duplicate commit): 1,720,000
-- delta: 860,000 tokens (overbilled)
```
Tess Morgan: Whoa that's a big delta. What's the dollar impact?
Owen Li: Using their blended token rate that's $86.00. Need finance confirmation for one-off refund and ledger correction.
Hassan Ali: We need to be careful writing corrections. Finance: do you want us to run a reversing backfill (idempotent correction) or issue a customer credit and keep ledger as-is?
Maya Brooks: Nimbus wants the invoice corrected. Finance preference is to correct the ledger so future invoices match. Approve a reversing backfill and a customer credit if needed for the period where invoices already issued.
billing-bot: Precheck: reversing-backfill requires (1) snapshot export (2) dry-run producing CSV + checksum (3) finance approval.
Tess Morgan: I'll run dry-run of the reversing backfill to produce per-event diffs and a checksum. Will include original txn_id and commit hashes. ETA 4 hours.
Owen Li: Also opened ENG ticket ENG-4551 to fix commit idempotency: make commit path check ledger txn_id and make backfill runner write a dedupe marker in a separate table that survives retries.
Hassan Ali: Finance: please confirm refund workflow. If we correct ledger and reissue invoices, we need sign-off from accounting for historic invoice adjustments.
Maya Brooks: Approve reversal of duplicate backfill and ledger correction. We also approve a one-time $86.00 credit if invoice had already been paid. Please attach CSV and md5 checksum to the customer note. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Automated note: dry-run required before commit. Scheduling dry-run job.
Tess Morgan: Dry-run finished and uploaded: s3://fin-audit/dryruns/1802509999-reverse-dryrun.csv md5=9f2c7b3a5d6e4f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c. CSV contains 1,200 rows; reversing tokens sum=860000.
Owen Li: I'll prepare the exact reversing transaction that will decrement the duplicate commits and include audit markers. Backfill will be a single idempotent transaction referencing the original backfill_run_id.
Maya Brooks: Draft customer note for Nimbus: "We discovered an internal backfill ran twice, which caused duplicated token entries on your April invoice. We will correct our ledger immediately and issue a one-time credit of $86.00 to offset the duplicate charges. Attached is the audit CSV and checksums. We apologize for the error." Approve?
Hassan Ali: Approve wording. Accounting: please track as REF-2026-042 for reconciliation.
Tess Morgan: Running controlled commit now (write path will assert no existing reversal marker). I'll post status in this thread when complete. ETA 30m.
billing-bot: Commit job gated: awaiting accounting reconciliation ID and engineering dry-run checksum verification.
Maya Brooks: Once commit completes, please send corrected invoice and final CSV to the customer and mark ticket FIN-4092 resolved.
Owen Li: Reversal commit succeeded. Ledger now shows expected tokens for the window (1,720,000). Post-commit diff CSV uploaded: s3://fin-audit/commits/1802509999-commit.csv md5=2a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d
Tess Morgan: Confirmed invoice adjustment generated. Notifying customer. Closing ENG-4551 was blocked until idempotency fix merged; PR opened and under review.
Maya Brooks: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and add a detection alert for duplicate backfill runs.
